lines.text: Many learners say: I can't find a car place.
Better: I can't find a parking spot.
Americans say parking spot or parking space.
Spot! It took ten minutes to find a parking spot.

data.wrong: I can't find a car place.
data.right: I can't find a parking spot.
data.why: Americans say parking spot or parking space.
data.memory: one car = SPOT, many cars = LOT

quiz.stem: It took ten minutes to find a parking ___.
